cmd:
cat > /tmp/manual_gen.sh <<'EOS'
#!/bin/bash
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo || exit 1
P=/usr/bin/python3
echo "=== start $(date -u +%T)"
timeout 100 git fetch -q origin main --depth 30 --update-shallow; echo "fetch rc=$?"
echo "=== step1 analysis $(date -u +%T)"
timeout 290 $P scripts/generate_ai_analysis.py --force-gemini 2>&1 | iconv -c -f utf-8 -t utf-8 | grep -v 'DeprecationWarning\|now_utc'
echo "=== step2 blocks $(date -u +%T)"
timeout 600 $P scripts/make_blocks_gemini_cloud.py 2>&1 | iconv -c -f utf-8 -t utf-8
echo "=== step3 push blocks $(date -u +%T)"
$P - <<'PY'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
import vps_ai_pipeline as v
v.git_push_ai(paths=v.BLOCKS_GEMINI_PATHS)
PY
echo "=== step4 video $(date -u +%T)"
timeout 700 $P scripts/make_video.py gemini 2>&1 | iconv -c -f utf-8 -t utf-8 | grep -v 'DeprecationWarning\|now_utc'
echo "=== step5 final push $(date -u +%T)"
$P - <<'PY'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
import vps_ai_pipeline as v
v.git_push_ai()
PY
echo "=== done $(date -u +%T)"
EOS
chmod +x /tmp/manual_gen.sh
nohup flock /tmp/vps_ai_pipeline.lock bash /tmp/manual_gen.sh > /tmp/manual_gen.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2; date -u; echo started
